description: This file defines a Java interface for the CursoRepository, extending JpaRepository to provide CRUD operations and custom queries for the Curso entity in a Spring Data JPA context.

classes.name: CursoRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for the Curso entity, providing custom query methods.

methods.name: findByNomCurso
methods.description: Retrieves a Curso entity matching the specified course name.

methods.name: findAllByProfesor
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Curso entities associated with the specified profesor.
